name: comp-66
title: Compact Textarea
blurb: Compact textarea with only 2 visible rows.
description: A shorter textarea using rows={2} and min-h-0 class to create a compact input field for brief text.
use_when: Short-form input like single-sentence comments or titles.
avoid_when: Users need space for longer multi-paragraph text.
a11y: Label linked to textarea. Rows attribute indicates expected height.
